title: cloud: check that the hosted Console page installs crypto.randomUUID on a non-secure origin like the released console's index.html (follow-up of #35645)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ④ · Source: fleet · ruling parameter 4 of #35645 (record 7073468878, maintainer 「A 关卡,不改代码」 2026-11-22T03:19Z; standing line 「需要转给 cloud的，应该立 cloud 车道卡」). Parked cloud-lane card.

## Why
#35645 was closed without a code change. The one guarantee for a non-secure origin (plain http, not localhost) is the inline script `installInsecureOriginRandomUuid` in `ui/apps/console/index.html` (objectui#4563). It installs `crypto.randomUUID` before any module loads. The decision thread measured the released console (`@objectstack/console@18.6.0`) on Chromium.
- With the script, list sorting works.
- With the script stripped from the page, a list with a configured sort does not render at all ("crypto.randomUUID is not a function", thrown by `toSortItems`).

The cloud-hosted Console page was not measured. If it is served from a different HTML shell, the guarantee may be missing there.

## Done when
- Read where the hosted Console's HTML comes from. Then confirm one of two things: it carries the same inline script ahead of the module scripts, or it is never served on a non-secure origin.
- If it is served on a non-secure origin without the script, add the script, or serve it from the console's own `index.html`, and pin it the way `insecure-origin-crypto.placement.test.ts` does.

reach: hosted Console on a non-secure origin; not measured (seat containers cannot reach `*.objectos.app`).
Business reason: if the guarantee is missing, a hosted customer on plain http sees lists with a configured sort fail to render.
Reader: the cloud lane.
Dedupe: `installInsecureOriginRandomUuid cloud`, `randomUUID hosted console` → only #35645.
Grade: p3, parked.
